\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
In regime I, fix the dimensionless control parameter at $p=0$; then
\begin{equation}
Trans(\omega)=p+0 .\label{regime-one}
\end{equation}
In a distinct regime II, fix the same notation at $p=1$; then
\begin{equation}
Trans(\omega)=p\cdot 1 .\label{regime-two}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
